connector.name: Salesforce by mindstone
connector.registryDescription: Salesforce CRM MCP server: accounts, contacts, opportunities, leads, tasks, and custom objects
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-salesforce. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mindstone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
